name: HC37j: Tested for Aspergillosis
description:
Number of active non-suppressed ART clients with CD4 below 200 who were tested for Aspergillosis.
Testing can be captured through aspergillosis_screening = 'YES' or the existence of an ASPERGILLOSIS RESULTS laboratory result. The concept dictionary confirms the latter as the appropriate result name.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND n.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND n.cd4_count < 200
  AND (
      UPPER(TRIM(n.aspergillosis_screening)) = 'YES'
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
          WHERE r.patient_id = n.patient_id
            AND r.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_parameter)) = 'ASPERGILLOSIS RESULTS'
            AND NULLIF(TRIM(r.test_value), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.is_valid_result = 1
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND COALESCE(
            v.sample_collection_date,
            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
            v.laboratory_result_date,
            v.order_date
        ) <= n.encounter_date
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
